description.en: SHOVIR evaluates vision shortcut learning in radiology report generation by extending MIMIC-CXR and PadChest-GR with per-box CheXpert labels. It defines image-level and disease-level occlusion experiments that compare model predictions on clean images against localized perturbations to isolate direct and contextual shortcut failures at the disease-class level.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Standard RRG metrics miss whether diagnostic statements are grounded in actual image evidence, allowing models to exploit dataset priors. SHOVIR provides a protocol to assess spatial grounding, revealing that high report quality can coexist with shallow visual reliance, which is critical for clinical deployment decisions.
